name: Taverner Ulf
title: The Last Climb
examine: Built like a door and about as easy to move. He keeps the first taproom inside the Silver Gate, which means he has heard every version of every story the High Road tells.
lines: The Flagon costs a day's wage and calls it atmosphere. Down here the atmosphere is free and the beer is honest.
Every carter says the same thing at the door: 'never again, that road.' Every carter is back in a month. I stopped saying goodbye years ago.
The dice table settles more disputes than the moot. Quieter, too, most nights.
